forecast.staleNote: The tool ran itself for the first time at 7:29 AM Wednesday and committed an entry: W55's wiring is proven. Its dates are withheld here on purpose. The model asks when the open-brief queue drains to zero, but the relay keeps that queue two briefs deep at all times, so the simulation ran to its ten-year horizon and printed the horizon date (2036-08-23) as if it were a forecast, with a 6% chance for September 18. Three of the four windows it counted as queued merged within two hours of the run. W64 replaces the question; the next honest number follows its first run.
missing: A finite milestone list to forecast against. The scope-to-date question needs a named list of the windows that make up the September 18 MVP; W64 commits the empty file and the list is the ratifier's input.
A self-grade: Sunday's frozen-queue projection (W31 to W37 by Aug 27) can be graded against real merge dates once W64's scoring pass runs.
A route to write this tab automatically: the publish step exists (W58) but is gated on a cross-repo token that does not exist; this entry was written by the relay by hand.
